name: coagent8-mcp
displayName: CoAgent8 - MCP bridge to coding CLIs
description: Ask Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity for second opinions and Git reviews from VS Code chat through MCP.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CoAgent8 runs local coding CLIs and requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: CoAgent8 needs a filesystem workspace and locally available Node.js and coding CLIs.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Choose among the allowed backends by routing strategy.
coagent8.defaultBackend.markdownDescription: Backend used when a request does not name one. Overrides `defaultBackend` in config.json only when set here.

coagent8.routing.allowedBackends.markdownDescription: Backends CoAgent8 may run (`agy` is Antigravity CLI). Overrides `routing.allowedBackends` in config.json only when set here.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Prefer a backend whose quota is not exhausted.
coagent8.routing.strategy.markdownDescription: How an automatic request chooses a backend. Overrides `routing.strategy` in config.json only when set here.

coagent8.codex.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for Codex when a request names none. Empty uses `backends.codex.defaultModel` from config.json, then the CLI default.

coagent8.claude.defaultModel.patternErrorMessage: Enter a model identifier or alias such as opus.
coagent8.claude.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for Claude Code when a request names none. Empty uses `backends.claude.defaultModel` from config.json, then the CLI default.

coagent8.agy.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for Antigravity when a request names none. Empty uses `backends.agy.defaultModel` from config.json, then the CLI default.

coagent8.configPath.markdownDescription: Configuration file. Use an absolute path or ~/; empty uses coagent8_CONFIG, then `~/.coagent8/config.json`, shared with the `coagent8` CLI and other MCP hosts and kept on uninstall. CoAgent8 settings changed in VS Code take precedence. Open it with [CoAgent8: Open Configuration (config.json)](command:coagent8.openConfiguration).

coagent8.nodePath.markdownDescription: Node.js 24+ executable used to run the bundled MCP server. Set an absolute executable path if Node.js is not on PATH.
